CREATE TABLE entry_metric_value_goal ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, metric_goal_id BIGINT NOT NULL, unit_id BIGINT NOT NULL, expected_value NUMERIC(19,5) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_metric_value_goal_metric_unit UNIQUE (metric_goal_id, unit_id), CONSTRAINT fk_metric_value_goal_metric FOREIGN KEY (metric_goal_id) REFERENCES entry_metric_goal (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_metric_value_goal_unit FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES dictionary_item (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_metric_value_goal_metric ON entry_metric_value_goal (metric_goal_id); CREATE INDEX idx_metric_value_goal_unit ON entry_metric_value_goal (unit_id);
